ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within $\angle AOB$, $OD$ is the bisector of $\angle BOC$, and $OE$ is the bisector of $\angle AOC$. If $\angle AOB=140^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle EOD$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since OD is the bisector of $\angle$BOC, and OE is the bisector of $\angle$AOC, \\
therefore, $\angle$DOC=$\frac{1}{2}$$\angle$BOC, $\angle$EOC=$\frac{1}{2}$$\angle$AOC, \\
thus, $\angle$DOE=$\angle$DOC+$\angle$EOC=$\frac{1}{2}$$\angle$AOB, \\
since $\angle$AOB=$140^\circ$, \\
therefore, $\angle$EOD=\boxed{70^\circ}.
